summary: Kimvula territory (Kongo-Central) lies on the Angolan border between Madimba/Mbanza-Ngungu and Kwango province, far from the eastern DRC conflict zones; no armed group is known to hold territory. Kimvula town and the rural villages are under ordinary state control, with the PNC as main force and FARDC/border elements present. Web research was unavailable for this run, so all zones rest on default state presence; rural villages near the Kwango border carry low confidence given the Mobondo militia's activity in the wider region.

Northern/eastern villages lie toward the Kwango province border where the Mobondo militia has been active further north-east, but no Mobondo presence in Kimvula is known.
